name: bladecp
description: BladeCP skills and MCP server for AI agents: migrate cPanel sites, manage servers, domains, apps and WordPress with the BladeCP CLI, operate your customers' services as a BladeCP partner, and read the BladeCP Developers documentation.

interface.shortDescription: BladeCP migrations, servers and partner tools
interface.longDescription: Migrate a cPanel full backup to BladeCP with the BladeCP CLI and follow it up to the private preview, inspect servers, usage, domains and migrations through the read-only BladeCP MCP, manage domains, apps and WordPress updates, operate your customers' servers, BladeCP Vibe accounts, marketplace, webhooks and migrations as a BladeCP partner, reach any Customer API route with bladecp api, and read the BladeCP Developers documentation without leaving your agent. Changes run only when you ask for them.
